[[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]]: *12.5% (Duo) *16.7% (Trio) *18.75% (Quad) |modifiers = [[Legacy]] ([[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]]) |rewards = {{Coins|580}} & {{Exp|100}} (Originally) }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Golden''' mode, internally referred to as '''Hard''' which is also its former name, was one of the four main survival modes. It is currently playable again through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it is quite different from its original version. '''Golden''' mode has 40 waves. It was named after its final boss, the [[Gold Titan]]. The [[Legacy]] modifier is active on this map. It makes it so that any modern enemy spawned in is replaced by its legacy variant. In this mode, shared cash was 35% (for example if someone else damaged an enemy by 10 health, you would receive {{Money|4}}). In the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] recreation, it uses the new income system, though as the enemies have no set up cash values, they all give {{Money|5}} on death. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreases by 25%, which means that in a quad, you only get 25% of the cash. This amount is distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player has not dealt any damage, they will receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which is 12.5% in duo, 16.7% in trio and 18.75% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. For example, the [[Abnormal]] gives {{Money|5}} when killed in solo, {{Money|3.75}} in duo, rounded up to {{Money|4}}, {{Money|2.5}} in trio, rounded up to {{Money|3}} and {{Money|1.25}} in quad, rounded down to {{Money|1}} between the players that damaged it. Players that did not damage it receive {{Money|0.625}} in duo, rounded up to {{Money|1}}, {{Money|0.835}} in trio, rounded up to {{Money|1}} and {{Money|0.9375}} in quad, rounded up to {{Money|1}}. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. Any rewards that end in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, there are no rewards. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|12}} × Waves + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only) |{{Exp|2}} × Waves Completed × {{Exp|1.25}} (Triumph Only) |} ===Badges=== There was a [[badges|badge]] which you could obtain when playing this mode, which had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. That badge was: {{Badge |title = Obtained Cowboy |rewards = [[Cowboy]] |image = Cowboy5.png |obtainable = No }} ==Enemies==

==Wave Structure== In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, '''Golden''' mode has multiple formulas for calculating the wave bonus. Between Waves 1-10 and between Waves 30-40: :({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|150}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) Between Waves 11-20 and on Wave 30: :({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|200}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) Between Waves 21-28 and on Wave 30: :({{Money|200}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|350}}) ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) On Wave 29: :{{Money|15,000}} ÷ (1 - 0.08 × Players) The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed. It is 35% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 20%. When it was originally in the game, the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|45}} - 3 × (Players - 1)) × Waves Completed The waves in '''Golden''' mode followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="margin:0 auto;" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-29 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:39. |- |30-38 |1:20 |0:26Skip at 0:53. |- |39 |2:00 |0:40Skip at 1:19. |- |40 |99:99 |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. For former wave structures of '''Golden''' mode, visit the [[Golden Mode/Waves|Waves]] page.
